task: Input-feature and online adaptive solver portfolio
historical: All previous inputs/results, including former holdouts, are development. Local checkpoint operators and different TL are not merged into full TL280 labels.
classification: Dimensionless physical features; leave entire instance+all seeds out in development diagnostics. Static tree failed to beat constant geometry; no runtime input hash/id/file-name/seed routing.
new_method: Two native experts on one compute worker each, common best verified publisher, optional in-invocation incumbent exchange; race observed at .40TL or .55TL for ns>2000/pressure>1/negative geo correlation. Promote only if >2% objective gap and observed slope projection also favors leader; otherwise preserve both. Cancellation precedes second-worker start.
selection: Among operationally valid portfolio configurations choose greatest mean improvement over v10 on screen, prefer worst>=-5% vs v4 if any. This is a short-budget development screen. Confirm full TL280, two seeds, fixed8-case subset with both controls. No fresh inputs before selection/freeze. If long development has material implementation failures repair on development only, retain all revisions; do not call short score confirmation.
promotion: 100% candidate valid, rc0, no emergency/error, wall<300; equal-case means>0 vs exactv4 and geometryv10; case-bootstrap95 lower>0 vs v4; worst pair vs v4>=-1%. Otherwise candidate experimental. All primary rows preserved; fixed-seed wall scheduling does not guarantee bitwise answers.
resources: Matched (case,seed) same two CPU affinity, randomized variant order, GNUtime and /proc thread runqueue/runtime plus PSI snapshots. 5 slots distinct physical cores, controller14/15. No exclusive-machine claim. If primary promotion passes but CPU/wall range>.5 in a matched block, one predeclared viewed-case repeat on largest-disparity case, same3seeds/all3versions/3slots may veto on worst<-1% vs v4 or any operational failure; never replace primary.
preservation: New directory only, no removal, no staging/commit/push/submit. Source versions and canceled/failed logs retained. Read only current instance/write only solution in packaged runtime.
